# Home use from simple inputs (next day and next 7 days)

*Generated by `python -m solvia.pipeline --steps model_home_simple`. Prayas eMARC homes; validation Jul–Dec 2019; models fitted on train only for every number below; the eMARC test split is not used.*

Inputs: last 7 days of units, type of home, date, temperature of the target day and the 3 days before.

## Next day (validation MAE, kWh/day)

| Model | MAE |
|---|---|
| ridge | 0.716 |
| hist_gradient_boosting_relative | 0.727 |
| ensemble **(selected)** | 0.711 |
| baseline_mean_7d | 0.763 |

With the target-day temperature replaced by the normal for the month: 0.720 kWh/day, so a poor temperature forecast costs little.

## Next 7 days (recursive; 171 start days, 106 homes)

| Day ahead | Model MAE | 'Last 7 days' average' MAE | Weight of the model | Used MAE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.679 | 0.735 | 1.0 | 0.679 |
| 2 | 0.781 | 0.804 | 0.5 | 0.777 |
| 3 | 0.837 | 0.843 | 0.5 | 0.824 |
| 4 | 0.846 | 0.844 | 0.5 | 0.827 |
| 5 | 0.902 | 0.895 | 0.5 | 0.877 |
| 6 | 0.938 | 0.921 | 0.5 | 0.907 |
| 7 | 0.943 | 0.909 | 0.5 | 0.894 |

The weight per day ahead (1 = model, 0.5 = half each, 0 = last 7 days' average) is chosen on these validation days, so 'Used MAE' is slightly optimistic.

80 % range: half-width = validation quantile of the error relative to the 7-day mean, per day ahead; it contained 80% of the validation days (in-sample, by construction ~80 %).
